name: Foundaura
tagline: An AI co-founder that turns a business idea into a launch-ready plan.

awards: Best Use of Snowflake API by MLH

problem: Most people with business ideas never start, citing funding and not knowing how.
solution: Guides users from idea to legal, financial and launch steps with AI, storing plans in a data platform.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter an idea and get a structured business plan.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Snowflake API by MLH” among 195 submissions.
Opens with survey statistics on unfounded businesses.

lessons: Database prizes reward the data model behind the plan.
